readiness_gaps.classification: Required before future LIVE enablement, not an existing offline authorization escape
readiness_gaps.actual: No service-owned outbound manifest/experiment approval registration or outgoing-message validator is wired into BudgetedProvider or ProtocolAttemptRunner. Budget scope checks ids/tools/model/caps and authorization, not the exact four-package/phase wire field allowlist. Registered contract input/resource hashes narrow today offline jobs but do not establish the proposed full outbound manifest.
readiness_gaps.minimum_change: Controller freezes independent experiment_id, approval identity/expiry, package/phase mapping and versions, material hashes, prompts/tools versions, derivation/field allowlist and immutable acceptance seal. Enqueue references this sealed policy, never client gold. Runner validates copied exact outbound envelope before preflight/DB reserve; provider validates the identical private final body fingerprint immediately before transport. Preserve denial before slot/send wherever possible.
acceptance: Unlisted authorized project resource, changed package/hash/version, extra payload field or altered prompt/tool rejected with zero sends
Source/extract cannot read or embed cold package bytes; cold may send only current approved new material plus separately accepted candidate instructions
Authorization revoke/expiry and mutable body alteration between checks reject; frozen private body equals Attempt request fingerprint and egress sealed envelope

readiness_gaps.classification: Required DB policy to claim executable six-stage14 plan
readiness_gaps.actual: DB pool enforces total14/64000 and pending-stop, but has no global six-stage counts/8000-or24000 limits/6-second spacing/300-second stage deadline. These reside in each BudgetedProvider file; protocol factories create separate run-scoped sidecars. ProtocolAttemptRunner does not bind provider.stage to accepted phase/shape. Global RPM is not the proposed >=6-second rule.
readiness_gaps.minimum_change: Under existing shared pool lock add sealed service stage identity (A/B and phase), per-stage first start/request/reserved/known accounting and last known settlement timestamp. Derive stage from controller accepted mapping, not arbitrary factory label. Check stage3/1/3 and8k/24k/deadline on reservation. With one inflight, >=6 seconds after last known settlement conservatively guarantees spacing without claiming reservation time equals actual send time. Unknown stays stopped. Decide whether300seconds is dispatch deadline or full stage wall; full wall requires remaining-deadline transport timeout and completion check.
acceptance: Cross-Run/project/process calls in same stage share3/1/3 and token limits
A source Run cannot choose cold/extract label; fresh sidecar cannot reset stage count/start/rate gate
Deterministic same-time cross-Run request rejected without send; after six seconds allowed if capacity remains
Stage expiry across process restart rejects, late transport completion is handled explicitly and cannot claim deadline success

readiness_gaps.classification: Required exact data review; no proven current gold leak
readiness_gaps.actual: ModelProtocol.extract_candidate sends source evidence including output/tool trace; cold sends model-generated node.instruction, inputs and output_schema. _no_gold recursively forbids named keys but cannot detect an old answer or forbidden content embedded in free strings. Registered gold is not read into request construction; hashes/proof are not gold values.
readiness_gaps.minimum_change: Explicitly freeze permitted source-evidence projection and trusted read receipt projection in the manifest. Before cold, independently approve exact accepted candidate instruction fingerprints/allowed derived fields, or constrain them with a sound bounded construction; do not assert arbitrary language instructions are old-answer-free because keys pass a denylist.
acceptance: Capture actual Mock wire and compare each phase full bytes to independently authored permitted projection
Sentinel gold/rubric/private reasoning/other-project/cold-before-cold values absent from all actual source/extract/cold request bodies
Candidate containing literal source-answer sentinel in cold instruction is blocked before send by policy, not merely excluded by a test generator
